Name: Ordinary Harvey and Yandere Harvey Portraits for Portaiture
Author: Gabihime
Description:
Needle and scalpel warning for the yandere portraits.  He’s just a doctor, doing doctor things.

Do you ever think to yourself “what’s really missing in my life are the perfect portraits of Harvey”?  Well, even if you don’t, have I got a deal for you.  Now you can choose between two different sets of Harvey portraits for Portraiture.  

Try Ordinary Harvey for a very ordinary doctor who likes model airplanes and doesn’t have any murderous tendencies (probably).  Or opt for Yandere Harvey and have a more thrilling experience where you might end up sedated or locked in a cellar!  Don’t worry.  Harvey always has your health in mind, and makes sure to carry first aid supplies wherever he goes.

Yandere Harvey is best enjoyed with either the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17763]Yandere Harvey[/url]﻿ dialogue mod or the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12302]Harvey: Preexistent Lovers[/url]﻿ mod, but you don’t need either!  Slap that yandere portrait on vanilla Harvey and enjoy how unhinged everything he says becomes!

I also suggest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15234]the portrait set by LT4823[/url]﻿.  These weren’t made to match that set, but more to be friends with it, as this is the set that I use myself.

For mod creators, both sets do come with additional bonus expressions, and there is only one shared expression throughout the two sets, so make use of all of them if you like.

These are currently set up for use with Portraiture.  Simply download the set you want and put it in the assets folder of Portraiture.  I did these at 512 resolution, so I will be looking at doing an HD Portraits version of these at some point when I have more time.

Please love Harvey.  If you don’t, something unfortunate might happen to the people of Pelican Town.
